snippet.title: Cathode Quest 64 [N64 GameJam 2025]
snippet.description:
My Entry for the N64Brew GameJam 2025, which just ended on the 1. Feb. 2026.
The theme for this year was: "Repair".

Cathode Quest is a little jump-n-run game where you collect fragments to restore parts of the level.
Featuring 2 Levels with a bunch of platforming, and one final ending using the large-texture rendering i showed before on this channel.
Sadly i did run out of time, and spend a bit too much time on some engine/tooling work.
So levels are a bit empty, and general things are a bit unfinished.
Would have loved to get some more SFX and FX in, as well as objects/enemies to interact with. But oh well....

ROM/Source can be found here:
https://github.com/HailToDodongo/pyrite64/releases/tag/gamejam

Also check out all the other GameJam entries here:
https://tinyurl.com/tremdctf
